Grêmio have won their last two outings before stumbling, while Bolívar sit somewhere between inconsistent and frustrating—lots of draws and losses mixed in. The injury list for Grêmio (F. Amuzu, J. - **Grêmio's attack** needs to click despite missing J. Pedro, relying on M. Braithwaite and Tetê to carry the load upfield
- **Bolívar's home fortress** at altitude could muddy the water—they're tougher at Hernando Siles than on the road
- **Defensive stability** is the real story; Bolívar gave up 2+ goals in their last three, and Grêmio's backline will be tested

- **Bolívar**: C. Lampe, J. Sagredo, X. Arreaga, I. Gariglio, S. Echeverria, P. Rodríguez, R. Matheus, L. Justiniano, E. Vaca, D. Romero
